التقيتن (form VIII)
# اِلْتَقَيْتُنَّ (iltaqaytunna) /il.ta.qaj.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِلْتَقَى (iltaqā)
# اُلْتُقِيتُنَّ (ultuqītunna) /ul.tu.qiː.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِلْتَقَى (iltaqā)
